load_video_features: load video features from .pt files in a directory with optional max clip sampling
visual_feature_sampling: sample visual features to a fixed number of clips using uniform temporal pooling
compute_overlap: compute IoU overlap between predicted and ground truth temporal interval lists
time_to_index: convert start and end time values to discrete index positions given num units and duration
pad_video_seq: pad a list of video feature tensors to a uniform max length with zero padding
